title: Envoy of the Demonic Path
next_chapter_hook: When that face, identical to his own, dissolved in the Void, a whisper from the depths of Heavenly Providence rang in Chen Ji's ear — the gate to the Ultimate Hall had opened for him.

text.content: Black demonic patterns squirmed like living things across the crumbling walls of the ruined temple. Ye Qing's seemingly ordinary paper crane had transformed into a blazing talisman, shrouding the entire ruined temple in an eerie violet-red glow. Chen Ji frowned, his fingers instinctively brushing against the warm fragment against his chest — the Tianji Record was vibrating at an unprecedented frequency, as if warning him of something. "They've come." His voice was low and calm, yet a cold gleam flickered in the depths of his pupils. A sound of air being torn apart echoed outside the temple as a figure, cloaked in overwhelming demonic aura, descended from the sky. The black mist swirling around the newcomer churned like a living organism, and his cultivation had reached the pinnacle of Transformed Deity.

The visitor was a woman draped in black纱, her face hidden in the shadow of her hood, only those crimson eyes glittering in the darkness. She knelt on one knee, her voice hoarse yet reverent: "The envoy of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path pays respects to the one guided by the Saint. I bear the Commander's words." Chen Ji said nothing, merely standing with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at her calmly. The self-immolation of Ye Qing's paper crane was no coincidence — she had foreseen this moment long ago. How many secrets did this woman still harbor that he knew nothing of? Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered within the depths of the Tianji Record, seemingly reminding him: Be careful. What comes next may shake your entire understanding of this world.

The envoy's voice echoed through the empty ruined temple, each word carrying a mesmerizing rhythm: "The Commander speaks thus: Chen Ji, the existence sealed within you is neither a so-called curse nor a remnant grudge, but rather your other half, connected by blood and bound by fate." She slowly raised her head, revealing the face beneath the hood — it was a狰狞 face covered in诡异 demonic patterns. "The world knows the Tianji Record can glimpse Heavenly Secrets, yet they do not know its true purpose: to seal the other soul that should not exist in this world." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and the Tianji Record on his chest blazed with sudden heat, as if responding to the envoy's words. He felt the long-dormant power deep within his Dantian stirring, like a slumbering beast catching the scent of blood.

dialogue.content: "Fated Twin Born..." Chen Ji murmured these four words, his voice carrying a tremor he himself had not anticipated. "Indeed." A诡异的 smile curved at the corner of the envoy's lips. "You were originally two halves of the same soul — one sealed within the Tianji Record to become a Prophet, the other cast into reincarnation to become a mortal. The Eye of Heavenly Providence would not permit a complete Prophet to exist, for that would mean —" She paused, a glimmer of reverence and terror flashing in her eyes. "— it would mean the ability to see through every chess game it has set in motion." Chen Ji's fists slowly tightened within his sleeves, his knuckles whitening from the force. So that was it. The incompleteness of the Tianji Record was no accident, but rather a deliberate suppression.

text.content: Just then, the temperature outside the ruined temple plummeted, and a suffocating pressure filled the air. Chen Ji raised his head sharply to see an even more terrifying aura hurtling toward him from the distance — where that power passed, even space itself began to distort and shatter. The envoy's expression changed drastically as she hastily prostrated herself: "Commander... the Commander has arrived in person!" Chen Ji felt that aura closing in on him, and with every step closer, the Tianji Record against his chest burned hotter, as if responding to some long-lost calling. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently fluctuated within the Tianji Record, emitting a string of urgent warnings — "Be careful! It's coming! The one who shares your very face —"

dialogue.content: A slender figure stepped slowly out of the distorted space, his black robes rustling without wind. As the newcomer's features gradually clarified, Chen Ji's pupils contracted the moment he saw that face — it was almost identical to his own, the only differences being a tear-shaped mole at the corner of the eye and the阴鸷 darkness in the gaze. "We finally meet, Chen Ji." The Demonic Commander's voice was low and magnetic, carrying an inexplicable sense of intimacy. "Or should I say — we have always been one." Chen Ji forced himself to remain composed and said coldly: "Who are you?" The Demonic Commander gave a light laugh, and with a wave of his hand, a illusory image unfolded in the air — a pair of twin infants, torn apart by an invisible hand, half sealed into a yellowed ancient scroll, the other half cast into the river of reincarnation.

text.content: "I am your other half, Chen Ji." The Demonic Commander's voice reverberated through the ruined temple, each word striking Chen Ji's heart like thunder. "A millennium ago, the Eye of Heavenly Providence separated us because, whole, we possessed the power to overturn its chess game. The Tianji Record is merely the tool that seals us, and every prophecy you have made over these years has unknowingly weakened this seal." Chen Ji stared fixedly at that face identical to his own, emotions churning within him beyond description. He had countless times questioned why he had been chosen by the Tianji Record, why fate had blessed atrash so generously — now the answer was revealed. Everything he possessed was nothing more than the crumbs and leftovers of his other self.

dialogue.content: "What do you want?" Chen Ji's voice regained its composure, the coldness that had been tempered through countless life-and-death trials. The Demonic Commander showed appreciation in his expression: "Impressive. You see through my purpose in coming here." He took a step forward, demonic qi churning around him, yet strangely unable to harm Chen Ji in the slightest. "Become one again, and we can completely free ourselves from the control of the Eye of Heavenly Providence, becoming true chess players rather than pieces." His eyes burned with炽热的 ambition. "I can help you fully awaken the power within, allowing you to wield complete Tianji power without consuming Heavenly Fate. There is only one condition —" He extended one finger. "In the Ultimate War, you must stand on our side."

choice.prompt: The Demonic Commander's proposal echoed in his ears — a choice sufficient to alter destiny. Accepting might grant the power to oppose Heavenly Providence, yet it also meant binding oneself to the war chariot of the Demonic Path.

choices.text: Test the other party's bottom line
choices.description: Do not rush to take a stance; first probe the Demonic Commander's true intentions and cards. Know yourself and know your enemy, and you need not be troubled by any battle.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence regarding the Eye of Heavenly Providence and the Fated Twin Born
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Commander may see through your intentions

text.content: A playful smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's lips: "Stand on your side? Sounds tempting, but what I want to know is — if I refuse, what will you do?" A flicker of surprise flashed in the Demonic Commander's eyes, followed by a hearty laugh: "Good! As expected of someone I admire — neither servile nor overbearing." He clapped lightly. "Rest assured, I will not force you. After all... power obtained through coercion would also be incomplete."

Chen Ji sensed sincerity in the other party's words, but more than that, a condescending arrogance — the posture a hunter assumes when facing prey. He coldly thought in his heart: Trying to manipulate me with rhetoric? Mo Xiansheng was right; this person knows far too much. Since he wants cooperation, let him show sufficient筹码 first. "You said the Fated Twin Born are two halves of the same soul — then why did the Tianji Record choose you and not me?" Chen Ji posed his first question. The Demonic Commander's smile faltered slightly, the阴鸷 in his eyes deepening. "...That is another story."

choices.description: Since the other party has needs, this is a transaction. Ask high, come down low — I have my own筹码.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain the Demonic Path's intelligence network and resource support
choices.risk_hint: The other party may think you insatiably greedy

text.content: "Cooperation is possible, but I have conditions." Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his momentum not losing to the other party in the slightest. "First, I need all intelligence on the Eye of Heavenly Providence — not the parts you want me to know, but everything. Second, you of the Holy Sect should know better than anyone the whereabouts of my sister Chen Nian." The Demonic Commander's smile gradually faded. He stared at Chen Ji for a long while, as if reassessing this "trash." "You certainly dare to make demands." He said deeply. "However... regarding your sister — are you certain you want to know the answer?"

Chen Ji's heart tightened violently, yet his expression remained unruffled: "What do you mean?" The Demonic Commander sighed lightly, waving his hand to display a screen of light in the air — a young girl bound by countless chains, her face bearing a seven-point resemblance to Chen Ji, her eyes closed tightly, as if fallen into endless slumber. "Chen Nian is not merely your sister — she is the Heavenly Fate Key, the crucial element the Eye of Heavenly Providence uses to lock our fates." The Demonic Commander's voice was low and complex. "You think the Holy Sect took her? You're wrong. It was the Eye of Heavenly Providence using the Holy Sect's hand to take her away from you."

choices.description: Since fate wishes to separate us, then I will personally shatter the shackles of fate. Whatever the Heavenly Eye's gaze, my fate is determined by myself!
choices.visible_reward: May Directly Trigger the Other Half of the Power Within
choices.risk_hint: The Awakening Process is Dangerous and Unpredictable, May Lose Control

text.content: "Enough." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice cold as the Nine Abyss ice. "I don't care about fate's twin children, nor the Heavenly Eye's chess game. There is only one thing I know—" He abruptly raised his head, a trace of golden light flickering in his eyes as the Tianji Record on his chest exploded with a broken seal. "My fate is written by myself!" In that instant, a vast power like the sea erupted from within him, colliding violently with the Demon Path Commander's demonic energy. The entire ruined temple disintegrated under the impact of these two forces, and the ground for several li in all directions cracked like a spider's web. The Demon Path Commander's expression changed dramatically as he retreated several steps: "You've gone mad! An awakening of this magnitude will—"

Chen Ji felt a violent force tearing apart his meridians—that was the power of "the other half," filled with destructive desire, killing instinct, and an extreme yearning for freedom. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul frantically shouted in his Mental Sea: "Stop! Your body cannot withstand the full power at this stage!" But Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcibly suppressing the rampaging force. Golden patterns emerged on his skin's surface—that was the Tianji Record's seal fusing with his meridians. Agonizing pain crashed over him like tides, yet his consciousness grew increasingly clear—he saw it, saw the complete picture of that chessboard, saw the countless manipulated pieces, and saw the chess player looking down from above.

In the excruciating pain, Chen Ji heard the Demon Path Commander's voice ring in his ears: "See? That is the Heavenly Eye—it is not merely the final antagonist but the architect of this world's rules. It does not permit any existence to challenge its authority, which is why we were separated." Chen Ji struggled to maintain his consciousness's clarity. Through the golden light, he saw a massive eye in the void, coldly gazing at him. That eye had no pupil, only endless void and fathomless darkness. "Chen Ji..." A transmission beyond the concept of sound directly entered his Mental Sea. "Do you think you can escape my chess game? A thousand-year layout—how could you possibly overturn it in a single day?"

Chen Ji felt that oppressive might intensifying, as if an invisible hand was crushing him. The other power within his body also rebelled wildly, the two forces warring inside him, bringing unbearable agony. Just then, the Demon Path Commander suddenly struck, a stream of black demonic energy flowing into Chen Ji's body, temporarily suppressing the rampaging force. "I told you, I won't force you." The Demon Path Commander's voice carried an unusual weariness. "But you need to know, the Heavenly Eye has already noticed you. From now on, you and I will no longer be the only variables on its chessboard." He stepped back several paces, his expression becoming unprecedentedly solemn.

dialogue.content: "The Ultimate Hall." The Demon Path Commander spoke the final four words. "A thousand years ago I attempted to breach it alone, yet was shattered by the Heavenly Eye's power before even reaching the hall's exterior. Now that you've awakened partial power, we finally have the possibility of fighting side by side." He gazed deeply at Chen Ji. "When you're ready to face the final truth, come find me in the Demon Path Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. Then you will see—" His form began to dissipate. "—what secrets lie behind that familiar face." Chen Ji stood frozen, his mind echoing with the Demon Path Commander's final words before departure. Familiar face? His face was his own face—what secrets could there possibly be?

text.content: The messenger waited nervously to the side. Seeing that the Demon Path Commander had departed, he hastily stepped forward to present a black Jade Slip: "This is the communication Jade Slip left by the Commander. If you have any questions, you may contact him at any time." Chen Ji accepted the Jade Slip, sensing the pure demonic energy contained within. He tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, his gaze falling upon the gradually dissipating distorted space in the distance. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a sigh from deep within the Tianji Record: "Master, it seems your plan must be accelerated. The Heavenly Eye has already sensed your existence. Continuing to hide is no longer possible." Chen Ji did not speak, merely gazing quietly at that void. He knew—from this moment onward, his game of strategy against that ultimate chess player had only just begun.

choice.prompt: The Demon Path Commander had departed, but the information he left behind pressed against Chen Ji's heart like a heavy stone. The truth about Chen Nian, the Ultimate Hall, the Heavenly Eye's注视—everything pointed to an even grander game of chess.

choices.description: My sister is the core of everything. No matter where she is, I must find her. The Heavenly Eye used her to threaten me, and it must pay the price.
choices.visible_reward: May Obtain First-Hand Intelligence Regarding Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect and Heavenly Eye May Both Set Traps

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the Jade Slip in his hand tightly, a flash of determination flickering in his eyes. Chen Nian was his only weakness, his only relative in this world. The Heavenly Eye thought controlling her could control him—what wishful thinking. "Mo Xiansheng," he asked in his heart, "What do you know about Chen Nian?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment before slowly speaking: "Master, your sister's identity is far more complex than you imagine. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key is not merely a tool to lock away your fate—she herself is an independent existence..."

choices.text: Return to Tianqing Sect First to Stabilize the Situation
choices.description: Revealing my strength now is too early. I need to return to the sect and continue feigning weakness while gathering strength. At the same time, contact Su Qingyao and have her investigate the demon path's movements.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao May Notice Something Unusual

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging power within his body, then turned to walk back along the path he came. He had to return—Su Qingyao was still waiting for his news in the sect, and Ye Qing also needed him to provide cover. Moreover—he glanced down at the faintly glowing Tianji Record fragment on his chest—this awakening had consumed much of his Heavenly Fate. He needed time to recover. More importantly, the phrase "familiar face" kept lingering in his mind, filling him with a vague sense of unease. The Demon Path Commander looked exactly like him—why would he say "that familiar face"? Could it be... that there was a third face just like his?

choices.text: Immediately Contact Ye Qing to Verify
choices.description: The paper crane left by Ye Qing triggered all this—she must know more details. Moreover, her position as the Demonic Path Saint is special, perhaps she can provide intelligence from a different perspective.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the connection with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: May obtain secret intelligence from within the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may be hiding something

text.content: Chen Ji took out another paper crane from his sleeve—this was the token left by Ye Qing when she departed. He infused Spiritual Energy into it, and the paper crane immediately turned into a streak of flowing light and vanished into the night. After a moment, a cold voice sounded in his mind: 'You saw him?' It was Ye Qing's voice, carrying a hint of barely perceptible trembling. Chen Ji said in a deep voice: 'You knew this would happen all along?' Ye Qing was silent for a long while before responding: 'I don't know any more than you. I only know... you and him, are the variables the Heavenly Eye fears most. The Holy Sect needs you united, but we—' she paused, '—we prefer you separated forever.'

Chen Ji stood on the ruins of the ruined temple, gazing at the gradually brightening eastern horizon. The newly awakened power within his body was slowly subsiding, but the seal on the Tianji Record had cracked open a visible gap, no longer able to close completely. He lowered his head to look at his hands, feeling the newborn power flowing through his meridians—this was power truly belonging to himself, no longer needing to consume Heavenly Fate Value, no longer needing to rely on that fragmentary prophetic ability. However, the price of power was also heavy—the Heavenly Eye had already noticed him, the doors of the Ultimate Hall were slowly opening, and yet he still had too many mysteries unsolved.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul awakened from slumber, his voice more solemn than ever before: 'Master, what you saw today is merely one corner. Greater secrets lie hidden within the Ultimate Hall.' Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed: 'What secrets?' Mo Xiansheng's voice became elusive: 'A thousand years ago, my master Chen Xuan attempted to break into the Ultimate Hall seeking answers, but he failed. Before his failure, he left behind words—' the remnant soul's voice suddenly became exceptionally clear, '—'Within the Ultimate Hall, there exists a face familiar to all, and that is the true form of the Heavenly Eye'.' Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, and like lightning across his mind, the expression of the Demonic Path Commander flashed before him as he departed. When he said 'that familiar face,' did he not refer to himself, but rather—

text.content: At this moment, the first rays of dawn's sunlight pierced through the clouds and fell upon the earth, stretching Chen Ji's silhouette long. He stood upon the ruins, his robes rustling in the wind, his eyes blazing with unprecedented light. Heavenly Eye, Twin Stars of Fate, Ultimate Hall, Chen Nian—all the clues pointed in the same direction, all the chess games would meet their final resolution in that place. He slowly turned, walking toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect, his footsteps firm and steady. behind him, that face identical to his own once again surfaced in his mind, impossible to dismiss. The Demonic Path Commander said there was another familiar face within the Ultimate Hall—that face, in the end, belonged to whom?

As that face identical to his own completely dissipated in the Void, a whisper from the depths of Heaven echoed in Chen Ji's ears—the voice was ice-cold and mechanical, yet carried a chilling sense of familiarity: 'Chen Ji... you think you are the chess player? No, you are forever a piece. A thousand years ago, you were; now, you are; forever, you will be. The door to the Ultimate Hall has been opened for you. But the moment you step inside—' the voice abruptly stopped, replaced by an eerie laughter, '—you will understand why I needed to separate you brothers.' Chen Ji whirled around sharply, but saw nothing. Only the cracked seal on his chest glowed with a诡异的 golden light in the morning sun, as if foreshadowing the approaching storm.
